text:
helen-peopleops: quick flag 10 several interviewers reported that the latest calibrated rubric changes didn't show up in the Scheduler's 'prepare' emails this morning. Looks like some panels still have old guidance.

jia-recruiter: noticed this too. I opened the "backend-panel-v5" template and the UI showed the new language, but scheduled invites and the candidate-facing emails used v4 text. Candidates and interviewers confused.

devin-eng: thanks, investigating. Our sync job pushes templates to the calibration service and writes a copy into the scheduler cache. Any chance the push failed? Can you share a concrete example template id?

helen-peopleops: templ-backend-v5 is one. Example: new guidance added "prioritize low-latency tradeoffs" but invites still say "focus on design breadth".

ops-bot: automated alert: templates-sync-job failed 2001234200 -> 429 Too Many Requests from calibration-service (rate_limit).

devin-eng: 429 from calibration-service explains the push failures. We retried a few times but our code did exponential backoff with a short cap and then marked as 'stale' in cache. Looks like token rotation last night changed quota behavior on their side.

lars-security: FYI security rotated the template-pusher API key at 2001231000 for key-hardening. We added the new key last night but did not update the calibration-service allowlist for the new key id. Could be related to rate-limit-like 429s if they throttle unknown keys.

devin-eng: good catch. I'll validate the key id and handshake. In parallel, I'll add a safer retry path: queue pending template pushes in SQS-like queue and apply a per-template backoff + dead-letter. That will avoid marking cache stale on transient 429s.

jia-recruiter: short term, can we export a CSV of the updated guidance and attach it to the affected scheduled invites? We need interviewers to see the new guidance for today's onsites.

helen-peopleops: yes please. If we can patch scheduled emails with a short note and include the CSV as attachment, that'll do. How manual is that?

devin-eng: I can generate CSVs for the impacted templates and add them to the scheduler as attachments. Will require a small script to map template ids -> job ids. I can ship a small hotfix to attach the CSV for any template that failed sync in the last 24h. ETA ~90m.

lars-security: while doing that please do not log full template text to public logs; treat as PII-similar. Use redact flag when writing to S3. Also confirm the new key id is in the calibration-service allowlist before re-running all retries.

devin-eng: will do. Plan: 1) validate key handshake with calibration-service (10-20m), 2) generate CSVs + attach to pending invites for affected jobs (90m), 3) implement queue + backoff + DLQ for template-sync job (next week). Will also add telemetry event templates.sync_failure with reason,key_id,to avoid silent cache stale marks.

ops-bot: note: recent deploy 2001233000 updated template-syncer with faster-mark-stale behavior (feature-flag: aggressive-stale).

jia-recruiter: awesome. For comms, I'll send a quick note to interviewers in #interviewer-announcements: "If you received an invite this morning, please check updated guidance attached in follow-up email. If missing, DM People Ops." Can you provide the wording once CSVs are attached?

helen-peopleops: will do. Also can we add a small UI indicator on template edit: "Last synced to scheduler: TIMESTAMP (success|failed)" so PMs and recruiters can see sync status?

devin-eng: good idea. I'll add a status badge and link to sync logs behind a permission gate. ETA for badge: next release. For today we'll rely on CSV attachments.

lars-security: after fix please rotate the key id again only after we've confirmed allowlist and have a rollback plan. Also add brief runbook for key rotations involving external services.

helen-peopleops: thanks all 1. Please ping when CSV attachments are live and I'll push the interneal note.

devin-eng: will post PR + deploy notes when done. ETA for CSV attachments: ~90 minutes.
